notes: The manifest is durable runtime configuration. The stable server only interprets route/source/style/script metadata; all page-owned code remains on runtime. Ice Dragon is opt-in and persisted locally. Generated Ice Dragon artwork hydrates from browser-safe base64 text assets through ice-dragon-art-loader.js. Ice Dragon art v2 applies the juvenile companion to the sidebar brand, assistant avatars, and new-chat welcome orb, while the adult guardian is painted directly into the Chat message chamber so app surfaces cannot cover it. Chat boot stays behind the hydration guard until account-scoped state and, when relevant, Ice Dragon art are ready or the bounded fail-open timer expires.
